'''Clysm Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Calli Trilm]] within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="GP4" /> which shared its name with the [[Clysm system/Legends|Clysm system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="GP4" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Trilm was captured <ref name="GP4" /> by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="GP3">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 3]]</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and taken to [[The Prism]],<ref name="GP4" /> a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] operated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="GP3" />

Following the Clone Wars,<ref name="GP4" /> around 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="VaderDate">The various ''Darth Vader'' miniseries released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] date themselves to a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to early in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY]], thus placing the ''Darth Vader'' comics, including ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', around 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].</ref> Skywalker, now known<ref name="Film III">{{Film|III}}</ref> as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, traveled to The Prism to recruit its [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] into joining him in vanquishing a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] taking place on<ref name="GP4" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Following a violent [[Mission to the Prism|riot]] which broke out, Trilm was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the chaos. As [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] [[Laurita Tohm]] later surveyed the casualties, he noted Trilm within The Prism's [[Databank/Legends|databanks]] as being the leader of the Clysm Fleet.<ref name="GP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clysm Fleet was mentioned in the [[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|fourth issue]] of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. The issue was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="GP4" /> on [[August 22]], 2012.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54123/star_wars_darth_vader_and_the_ghost_prison_2012_4|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison (2012) #4}}</ref>
